title: Normalized ring and input-stalk coordinates for restriction to a source open
statement: Let f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S and g':X'→X form a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change], let U⊆X be open, T=X'×_X U with projections p:T→X' and s:T→U, z0∈T and z=p(z0). Assume the given derived categories of module sheaves exist for every scheme. Fix an unbounded complex P of O_X modules and its literal termwise restriction P0. The induced square is cartesian. Use the actual R,A,B,D stalk rings, left/right algebras, tensorMap and input-stalk complexes Q,Q0 of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. There exist ring isomorphisms eR,eA,eB,eD and a chain isomorphism q:Q≅restrictScalars(eA)(Q0) compatible with the R-to-A and R-to-B maps and carrying tensorMap(a⊗b) to tensorMap0(eA(a)⊗eB(b)). Moreover eD is precisely p.stalkMap(z0), and q in every degree is the inverse same-germ restriction-stalk map of U.ι preceded by the stalk congruence g'(p(z0))=U.ι(s(z0)). This statement constructs no tensor-complex isomorphism and contains no homology equation.

proof.text: Construct eA by the pullback point congruence followed by the open inclusion stalk map; eD is the open projection stalk map. Construct eR by applying f to the point equality and eB by the definitional equality f-prime(p z0)=(p followed by f-prime)(z0).

For general open j, prove the inverse stalk-ring germ formula by applying the injective j.stalkMap. Represent a scalar and a module germ on a common open; germ_smul and germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app prove semilinearity. Regard the same-germ map as a linear map on restrictScalars(j.stalkMap); its additive bijectivity and naturality give a linear natural isomorphism. Map it to complexes and invert. Equality induction on the point equality gives q and its specified component formula.

stalkMap_congr_point followed by stalkMap_comp proves R-to-A compatibility. The two point-congruence paths in S agree because stalkSpecializes_comp composes them, giving R-to-B compatibility. The two restrictions specifying tensorMap imply its pure tensor formula as a product of the two stalk-map images. Apply stalkMap_congr_hom to the pullback condition and stalkMap_comp to p followed by f-prime; multiplication preservation gives tensor compatibility.

theorem exists_openRestricted_stalk_coordinates
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (sq0 : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z0 : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u}))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := pullback.fst g' U.ι z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := leftAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    let R0 := R (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let A0 := A (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let B0 := B (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') z0
    let D0 := C z0
    let Q := stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q0 := stalkComplex (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0 P0
    let hp : g' z = U.ι (pullback.snd g' U.ι z0) :=
      congrArg (fun h : pullback g' U.ι ⟶ X => h z0) pullback.condition
    ∃ (eR : R f g' z ≃+* R0) (eA : A g' z ≃+* A0)
      (eB : B f' z ≃+* B0) (eD : C z ≃+* D0)
      (q : Q ≅ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q0),
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eA (algebraMap (R f g' z) (A g' z) r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eB (algebraMap (R f g' z) (B f' z) r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ (a : A g' z) (b : B f' z),
        eD (algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z) (a ⊗ₜ[R f g' z] b)) =
          algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b)) ∧
      eD.toRingHom = ((pullback.fst g' U.ι).stalkMap z0).hom ∧
      ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : Q.X k),
        (show Q0.X k from q.hom.f k x) =
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι (pullback.snd g' U.ι z0)).inv.app
            (P.X k) (((show X.Modules from P.X k).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hp)).hom x)
